# Physical contract fixtures

`page.json` is invented: two regions, multiple paragraphs, four words. It contains
no newspaper text or real people.

`impresso-page.schema.json` is the unmodified published Impresso page schema,
read 29 October 2026 at
https://impresso.github.io/impresso-schemas/json/canonical/page.schema.json,
byte-identical to `pruzhany-steps/schemas/page.schema.json`. Upstream source:
https://github.com/impresso/impresso-schemas/blob/329323c/json/canonical/page.schema.json
(master commit `329323c`, 13 August 2026). SHA-256:
`b6a6ca37167b30d318eb175a844dc50c80d245f9753ddc279a5e198b47f53b2c`.

Attribution: Impresso, `impresso/impresso-schemas`. Its GNU Affero General Public
License v3 is preserved verbatim in `IMPRESSO-LICENSE`. This is a test oracle,
not a second maintained definition. Tests neither download it nor update it.
Changing the oracle requires reading the upstream schema and reviewing the
definition and compatibility cases together.
